findings.title: Failure raw capture still depends on unchecked decoded JSON shape
findings.evidence: safe_capture returns any valid JSON value. outer/value/spec may be non-dict; a roster list member without selector causes line88 to throw outside collection try, before line97 persists failure_origin. The affected file may itself be the corrupted input responsible for stop.
findings.minimal_change: Persist a minimal raw failure envelope first, containing actual supplied outer exit, safe-captured outer/failure refs and no derived lookups. Normalize only interpretation (not rawbytes): dict/list/member guards; wrap all derived partition/model collection and record exceptions as diagnostics. Preserve raw JSON and unknown/null semantics. Never require valid spec/grant/current inputs to retain the original failure.

findings.title: Bind current sealing grant to actual launcher invocation
findings.evidence: launch.py stores invocation.grant with actual authorization bytes hash. Success sealer verifies outer stdout/stderr and runner but never verifies outer.grant against current authorization.execute.json. It also omits grant candidate/work_root/output_root equality to pinned spec and fixed REPLAY.
findings.minimal_change: Verify outer.grant actual hash/bytes/path, require its resolved path exactly N/authorization.execute.json; require candidate/spec.candidate/prepared.source_commit equality, work/output equality to pinned spec and actual replay constants. Keep current roster and runner checks.

findings.title: Preserve post-execution qualification failure separately from a successful controller exit
findings.evidence: Success-path validation is top-level with no diagnostic catch. A post-run current ref/vector mismatch produces only a new sealer traceback; it must not be reported as original controller/test failure or overwrite successful raw.
findings.minimal_change: Catch qualification/collection exceptions after reading actual outer outcome into a distinct immutable sealer-validation failure record and WITHHELD audit; preserve original outer/controller/native values and rawrefs. Do not create a false original G2 case failure when original outer=0. Maintain nonzero sealer exit and no retry.
